clubs.name: Giggle Galaxy
clubs.description:
Giggle Galaxy - A neon-inspired comedy club where laughter shines brighter than stars.

 Founded in 2021 by comedian and astrophysicist Gilbert Hurton , Giggle Galaxy brings laughter to the heart of the city. Known for its neon lights and futuristic vibe, the club quickly became a hub for both rising stars and humorists.

clubs.name: Rally House
clubs.description:
Rally House - nostalgic house music based on the play station two racing games of the early two thousands. 

 Founded by a mysterious figure only known as prod. DTM. Rally house is a place to relax and bop to dj sets that remind you of childhood

clubs.name: Jazz-corner
clubs.description:
Jazz Corner - A cozy jazz club that transports you to the golden age of jazz with its intimate ambiance and soulful performances.

 Established in 2015 by jazz enthusiast and saxophonist Lena Thompson, Jazz Corner has become a beloved venue for jazz lovers. The club's warm lighting, vintage decor, and exceptional acoustics create the perfect setting for unforgettable musical experiences.

clubs.name: The Pulse Room
clubs.description:
The Pulse Room - An electrifying nightclub that pulses with energy, where cutting-edge electronic music meets immersive visual experiences.

 Founded in 2023 by DJ and visual artist Maxine Vega, The Pulse Room is a haven for electronic music enthusiasts. The club features state-of-the-art sound systems, dynamic lighting, and interactive installations that create a multisensory experience for partygoers.

events.title: Starlight Standup
events.description: Starlight Standup invites you on a journey through laughter and light — where cosmic humor meets neon dreams, and every punchline shines brighter than the stars themselves.

events.title: Open Mic Night
events.description: The stage becomes a portal to the unknown as new voices echo through the neon haze. From rookie jesters to interstellar pros, every performer brings their own orbit of humor and heart.

events.title: The Laugh Battle
events.description: Two comedians. One stage. Infinite laughter. Watch as intergalactic rivals duel with punchlines, each joke more explosive than the last — until the crowd crowns the true Cosmic Comic Champion.

events.title: Improv in space
events.description: No scripts. No limits. Just spontaneous humor floating weightless in the Giggle Galaxy. Expect the unexpected as comedians create universes of laughter faster than light.

events.title: Miles Davis Tribute
events.description: En kväll dedikerad till Miles Davis, där vi utforskar hans banbrytande verk och inflytande på jazzhistorien.

events.title: Ella Fitzgerald Night
events.description: En varm och svängig kväll där vi firar Ella Fitzgeralds tidlösa röst och hennes mest älskade klassiker.

events.title: John Coltrane Celebration
events.description: En intensiv hyllning till John Coltranes mästerliga saxofonspel och hans spirituella jazzkompositioner.

events.title: Loius Armstrong Tribute
events.description: En kväll fylld med retro-futuristiska beats och neonljus som tar dig tillbaka till 80-talets synthwave-era.

events.title: Rhythm Awakening
events.description: A dance performance where light and sound interact in real time.

events.title: Neon Motion
events.description: Electronic dance night with a live DJ and visual light show.

events.title: Pulse Experiment
events.description: The audience controls the music through movement – feel the rhythm for real!
